description: CASE arms of different numeric widths widen to the wider type instead of taking the first arm's type

columns.name: effective_price
columns.note: THEN arm is an int64 literal (0), ELSE arm is msrp (decimal); PostgreSQL resolves the CASE to numeric

name: case_widens_to_decimal
query_sql:
-- @name GetEffectivePrice
-- @returns :many
SELECT CASE WHEN on_sale THEN 0 ELSE msrp END AS effective_price FROM order_items
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE order_items (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, msrp NUMERIC NOT NULL, on_sale BOOLEAN NOT NULL)
